36.12148,-81.67141: Emily Prudden 1832 1917. Missionary. Founded 15 western N.C. schools including Pfeiffer College forerunner. Her Skyland Institute stood here.
36.13274,-81.67825: Stoneman's Raid. On a raid across western N.C. Gen. A. C. Gillem led part of Stoneman's U.S. cavalry through this vicinity, March 28, 1865.
36.15194,-81.96379: Cranberry Mines. Iron ore deposits near here were mined from ca. 1826 until 1930. Supplied iron to the Confederacy.
36.21977,-81.68611: Ginseng Trade. Native root valued in China for medicinal uses; long collected by locals. Wilcox Drug (est. 1900), among its exporters, operated 175 yds. SE.
